Meet the Artist

Aishwarya Dake
Artist & Founder

I believe the right artwork can transform how a space feels.

I personally conceptualize and oversee every Colors N Joy project, creating original, handcrafted artworks designed specifically for each space—considering its architecture, proportions, textures and light.


The Studio

Where Creativity Meets Craftsmanship
Colors N Joy is a custom wall art studio specializing in:

- Texture & Relief Art
- Canvas Artworks
- Designer Art Clocks

Each piece is custom-designed to become a natural part of your space—not just wall décor.
